### prymitive/karma (ghcr.io/prymitive/karma)

### [`v0.134`](https://redirect.github.com/prymitive/karma/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#v0134)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/prymitive/karma/compare/v0.133...v0.134)

##### Fixed

- Silence ACL rules are now enforced when deleting silences via the proxy - [#​7170](https://redirect.github.com/prymitive/karma/issues/7170).
- Silence matcher sliders and label value suggestions now update correctly
  when editing a silence or changing the label name - [#​7221](https://redirect.github.com/prymitive/karma/issues/7221).

##### Added

- Silence ACL rules can now be scoped to specific operations (`create`, `edit`,
  `delete`), see [ACLs.md](docs/ACLs.md) - [#​7170](https://redirect.github.com/prymitive/karma/issues/7170).
